page.notes: Printed rules above and below the title block, the author line and the Scripture quotations are ornamental or set off by rules and are not separate headings. Dark scan borders, stains and show-through are excluded. The spelling "Hereses" and the long s forms were read from a degraded scan; the ligature in "Hereses" is uncertain. The title block uses large display type, which is why it is given as lines and not as a heading.
